name: tudl
description: tudl is a dataset from the BOP (Benchmark for 6D Object Pose Estimation) collection used to evaluate 6D object pose estimation algorithms. It provides RGB(D) images with ground-truth object poses for objects in cluttered or industrial scenes, enabling evaluation of detection, pose estimation, and pose refinement methods. The dataset is intended for benchmarking performance under realistic imaging conditions encountered in robotics and augmented-reality applications.
evaluation_method: pose_error / ADD(-S), recall-based metrics (average recall / AUC)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by object and metric; roughly 50–90%
reputation: Part of the widely used BOP benchmark suite for 6D pose estimation; recognized in the pose-estimation community though individual BOP subsets vary in adoption.
